tools.name: find_overlapping_accounts_and_leads
tools.description: Pulls a list of accounts you share with one or more partners. Supports filtering by partner, population, segment, and partner score — and can run across your entire ecosystem at once.

tools.name: get_account_context
tools.description: Get a unified view of one of your accounts. Returns account details, owner information, and population membership, including custom fields. Look up by domain, CRM record ID, or company name.

tools.name: find_partner_shared_contacts
tools.description: Find partner-shared contacts at an account. Surfaces decision makers, economic buyers, executive sponsors, and other key contacts your partners are sharing.

tools.name: find_new_accounts
tools.description: Returns accounts from Pipeline Generation — high-potential prospects based on where your partners already have customers, including net new accounts not yet in your CRM. Use for greenfield prospecting and net new pipeline generation.

tools.name: get_partner_overlaps_shared_context
tools.description: Returns the CRM fields a specific partner is sharing on a given account, including standard fields and any custom mapped fields like account tier or renewal date.

tools.name: find_partner_recommendations
tools.description: Returns ranked partner suggestions for an open opportunity, powered by the same recommendation engine as Deal Navigator.

tools.name: find_overlapping_partners
tools.description: Returns which of your partners have a given account in their data. Surfaces co-sell opportunities at the account level.

tools.name: get_partner_context
tools.description: Get a full picture of your partner relationships — overlap counts, open deals, potential revenue, partner score, win rate, deal size, and how recently each partner has been active. Filter by partner name, tag, or region.

tools.name: get_ecosystem_activity
tools.description: Surface recent partner activity across your ecosystem, ordered from latest to oldest. Delivers three signal event types: partner deals opened, partner deals closed won, and recent greenfield signals (deals a partner closed on a company that isn't in your CRM yet). Each event can include contact context from the partner's CRM when sharing is enabled.

tools.name: get_list_link
tools.description: Instantly generates a shareable Crossbeam list link using plain language — no need to navigate the UI. Works for both single-partner overlap lists and ecosystem-wide views.

tools.name: search_crossbeam_knowledge
tools.description: Answers "how does Crossbeam work" and shares Ecosystem-Led Growth best practices. Leverages our help docs, the ELG Insider blog, and the Ecosystem-Led Growth book as sources and references for suggestions and case studies.

tools.name: get_partner_suggestions
tools.description: Surfaces companies you don't yet partner with on Crossbeam, but should consider based on ecosystem fit. Powered by Partnerbase data, with a direct link to invite them.
